title: Juicy Roasted Dutch Couscous Gratin
description: A kid-friendly, macrobiotic-friendly Dutch dish featuring roasted vegetables and a crispy couscous topping.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of carrots, zucchini, bell peppers, and onions.

instructions: Toss the roasted vegetables with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
In a separate pot, combine the chicken broth and couscous.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Let the couscous cook for 5 minutes, or until it has absorbed most of the liquid.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in the feta cheese.
Transfer the roasted vegetables to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the vegetables with the couscous mixture and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
